recommendations.description: Launch a joint UM, claims, and reimbursement policy audit for CT Commercial Individual PPO prior-authorized acute hospital inpatient admissions, stratified by facility and focused on Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC and Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC, to verify prior authorization, level-of-care match, denial enforcement, and contractual pricing.
evidence: CT PPO authorized acute hospital activity added about +$23.2M.
174 more claims and 370 more admissions.
Paid per admit increased about $4.4K.
Craniotomy with MCC added about +$0.9M.
Chemotherapy with CC paid per admit up about $14.1K.
peer_benchmarking: United Health bundles routine facility services and supplies into hospital payment.
Cigna policy addresses pharmacy and infusion reimbursement, not DRG-based acute inpatient payment.

recommendations.description: Perform claims processing/reprocessing and auth-to-claim validation for Commercial Individual inpatient claims in CA, CT, GA, KY, TX, VA, and WI that carry AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION or Not Mapped facility values, prioritizing CT PPO Not Mapped claims and the provider and DRG pockets at Yale New Haven Hospital, Santa Clara Valley Medical Center, Aurora St. Luke's Medical Center, Parkland Health and Hospital System, Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, and Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC; restate the affected trend before any UM, reimbursement, contract, or site-of-care action.
evidence: CT PPO authorized Not Mapped facilities drove about +$4.7M.
CA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION added about +$1.3M before business action.
WI AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION added about +$1.1M before business action.
KY HMO Not Mapped facility spend added about +$1.1M.
All authorization-code groups are flagged for validation before action.

recommendations.description: Open a provider- and DRG-specific exception review for AURORA MEDICAL CENTER - SHEBOYGAN COUNTY and for Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC admissions in WI, GA, CO, CA, and TX to validate prior authorization on Y-coded cases, enforce authorization-denial edits, confirm contract-compliant inpatient reimbursement, and route large-dollar inpatient claims to itemized bill review.
evidence: AURORA MEDICAL CENTER - SHEBOYGAN COUNTY in WI is a named provider pocket.
Craniotomy with MCC drives named growth pockets in GA, CO, and CA.
TX sepsis admissions are a named high-growth service pocket.
Admissions up and paid per admit up across HMO acute hospital.
Source cards are flagged auth_dimension_present with pa_required_code Y.

recommendations.description: Conduct a focused claims, authorization, and contract audit for Commercial Individual KY HMO PA-required acute inpatient admissions at TRISTAR SKYLINE MEDICAL CENTER, prioritizing Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC, and if claims are contractually accurate, initiate targeted provider remediation or site-of-care steerage.
evidence: KY HMO authorized acute spend is concentrated at TRISTAR SKYLINE MEDICAL CENTER.
Broader KY authorized acute hospital spend rose with admissions up and unit cost up.
Tristar added spend on more admissions with exceptionally high paid per admission.
PA-required code is Y for impacted KY HMO acute hospital inpatient claims.
Degenerative nervous system disorders and sepsis were identified as main contributors.
peer_benchmarking: United Health policy reviewed was not applicable to DRG-based acute inpatient reimbursement.

recommendations.description: Launch a CA catastrophic inpatient policy review for Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, Major Chest Procedures with CC, and Cardiac Valve and Other Major Cardiothoracic Procedures without Cardiac Catheterization without CC/MCC at Santa Clara Valley Medical Center and Adventist Health Saint Helena: require itemized bill and coding validation, confirm authorization enforcement, and pursue provider-specific contract or site-of-care remediation for tertiary outlier cases.
evidence: CA rare high-cost findings total about $5.5M across two related clusters.
Santa Clara Valley Medical Center concentrated multiple craniotomy MCC outlier diagnoses.
Traumatic subdural hematoma cases averaged $479K paid per admit on two admissions.
Benign cerebral meninges admissions rose with higher paid per admit.

recommendations.description: Implement a TX focused inpatient utilization-management review for PARKLAND HEALTH AND HOSPITAL SYSTEM and BAYLOR UNIVERSITY MEDICAL CENTER across ACUTE HOSPITAL and Physical Rehab stays tied to HEMIPLG FLW CEREB INFARCT LT N-DOM, HEMIPLG NONTRM INTRCEREB HEM RT DOM, ENC ORTHOPED AFTERCARE FLW SURG AMP, and Acute Myocardial Infarction, Discharged Alive with CC to verify prior authorization, initial and concurrent review, site-of-care selection, and alternate discharge location planning.
evidence: HEMIPLG FLW CEREB INFARCT LT N-DOM concentrated at PARKLAND HEALTH AND HOSPITAL SYSTEM.
HEMIPLG NONTRM INTRCEREB HEM RT DOM surfaced in TX ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions.
ENC ORTHOPED AFTERCARE FLW SURG AMP occurred in Physical Rehab with pa_required_code Y.
BAYLOR UNIVERSITY MEDICAL CENTER surfaced for Acute Myocardial Infarction, Discharged Alive with CC.
peer_benchmarking: BCBS_TX lists outpatient-only cardiac biomarker restrictions; no inpatient neuro or rehab policy detail provided.
Humana lists limited ACS testing coverage; no inpatient site-of-care restriction appears in the summary.

recommendations.description: Audit KY Commercial Individual PPO ACUTE HOSPITAL inpatient claims with pa_required_code N for contract-standard adjudication, auth-to-claim status, payment policy edits, and provider/DRG outlier pricing; reprocess or remediate any identified contract exceptions.
evidence: KY PPO non-authorized acute hospital spend increased about +$2.1M.
Claims fell by 4 and admissions fell by 6.
Paid per admit increased about $21.1K.
Allowed per admit increased about $21.2K.
Paid ratio increased from 0.9418 to 0.9646.

recommendations.description: Require oncology UM and claims operations to review WI inpatient chemotherapy admissions at AURORA ST. LUKE'S MEDICAL CENTER for DRG Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC and diagnosis ENCOUNTER FOR ANTINEOPLASTIC CHEMO, validate PA-to-claim alignment, enforce denials for mismatched authorizations, and redirect planned non-ER cases to alternative sites of care when medically appropriate.
evidence: WI inpatient chemotherapy added about +$1.1M.
Admissions increased by 42 at AURORA ST. LUKE'S MEDICAL CENTER.
PA required code Y on non-ER acute hospital admissions.
ENCOUNTER FOR ANTINEOPLASTIC CHEMO drove DRG Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health internal bundles inpatient hospital DRG chemotherapy administration; Wisconsin and some exempt facilities are excluded.
United Health denies chemotherapy administration on facility and professional claims, not inpatient DRG adjudication.
Humana lists laboratory-only scope with no separate chemotherapy administration reimbursement.
